title: Retiree in Germany Reportedly Lost at Least €150,000 in Investment Scam Involving a Purported AI Imitation of Economist Hans-Werner Sinn's Voice
summary: A 73-year-old in Gilching, Bavaria, Germany, reportedly transferred at least €150,000 to a fake brokerage account that showed fictitious gains. He had reportedly seen a Facebook post with purported investment tips from economist Hans-Werner Sinn. Local police reportedly said a caller used an AI imitation of Sinn's voice to impersonate him. The transfers included funds belonging to the retiree's wife.
